preconditions.description: The number of points n must be between 1 and 100.
The number of segments m must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= xi <= 100 for xi in points)
preconditions.description: All point coordinates must be between 0 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= li <= ri <= 100 for li, ri in segments)
preconditions.description: All segment borders must be between 0 and 100, and li must be less than or equal to ri.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any_good_drawing else True
postconditions.description: If no good drawing exists, output -1; otherwise, output a valid drawing.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= color <= 1 for color in colors)
postconditions.description: Each color in the output must be either 0 (red) or 1 (blue).

postconditions.expression: all(abs(sum(1 for j in range(n) if colors[j] == 0 and li <= points[j] <= ri) - sum(1 for j in range(n) if colors[j] == 1 and li <= points[j] <= ri)) <= 1 for li, ri in segments)
postconditions.description: For each segment, the absolute difference between the number of red and blue points must be at most 1.
